craft_evidence.owned: No owned making (evidence). adidas AR 2025: "we outsource almost 100% of our production to independent manufacturing partners"; 92% of 2025 volume produced in Asia (Vietnam 27%, Indonesia 18%, China 16%); largest factory ~6% of volume. Only owned facilities named are distribution centres (21 of 60).
craft_evidence.makers: None on product pages (0 of 16 read). Company-level evidence: a Global Factory List (2026, July file) names suppliers, subcontractors and licensees by country, updated twice a year. It is not linked from products.
craft_evidence.mills: None on product pages (0 of 16 read).
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed (evidence): "adidas came to being on August 18, 1949" in Herzogenaurach. 1924 Gebrueder Dassler Schuhfabrik with Rudolf (brand 75-years factsheet, Aug 2024).
craft_evidence.process: Fabric construction is named per product (single jersey, twistknit pique, waffle knit, PRIMEKNIT, drop-needle). No making process is documented on the pages read.
craft_evidence.reasoning: The 16 product pages checked for origin say only "Imported", with no country, maker or mill, and the 2025 annual report says adidas outsources almost all production to independent partners, 92% of volume in Asia. Its one checkable making disclosure is the company-level Global Factory List, and the dated 1949 Herzogenaurach heritage is about the company, not where today's clothes are made. This sits between 1 and 2; 2 is proposed for the published factory list.
